encoding_notes: SOURCE HARD-BLOCKED: live Wiley author-guidelines page unrenderable via WebFetch (403), Apify headless (403/500 on direct URL and Google-search mode), Jina (401), allorigins (520); NO Wayback snapshot exists. Encoded from the live page's search-index content + Wiley/APA house style, per the invoking directive to encode Wiley house style with low confidence when hard-blocked. Classified TIER_B_blocked_shell.

PUBLISHER MIGRATION: European Journal of Sport Science moved from Taylor & Francis (tandfonline, tejs20) to Wiley and flipped to Gold Open Access on 2024-01-01 (APC $2,950 USD / £2,160 / €2,550; 20% ECSS society-member discount). The old tandfonline guide was deliberately NOT used as a source.

BLINDING confirmed high-confidence from the live Wiley page: 'The journal operates a double-anonymized peer review policy. Please anonymize your manuscript and supply a separate title page file.' -> double_blind, separate_title_page, scrub_body_identifiers, scrub_metadata all true.

FREE FORMAT SUBMISSION: EJSS uses Wiley Free Format ('Your manuscript should be an editable file including text, figures, and tables, or separate files - whichever you prefer'). Consequently layout numerics (font, size, spacing, margins, page size, alignment, indent) are NOT mandated at submission and are left null; line_numbers left 'none' as conservative default (enum has no null; not verified).

ARTICLE TYPES: Wiley page states the journal 'publishes original research as well as review articles' and invites 'original research and systematic reviews' -> original_research, review, systematic_review. Letters/editorials/short communications were NOT confirmed on the reachable content and are omitted rather than guessed.

SECTIONS (original research) confirmed from live page: 'the main body is formatted as introduction, materials & methods, results, discussion, conclusion.' Encoded for original_research only; no prescribed order confirmed for review/systematic_review.

REFERENCES: live page states 'APA reference style; as the journal offers Free Format submission, however, this is for information only and you do not need to format the references.' APA has no exact enum slot (enum = nlm/ama/vancouver/custom, all numbered) -> mapped to 'custom'. in_text=paren, order=alphabetical, journal_abbrev=full, include_doi=true encode APA author-date house style; et_al_threshold and max_count left null (the guide does not restate APA author-count rules).

FIGURES: live page states 'Electronic graphics files for the illustrations should be in Encapsulated PostScript (EPS), PDF or TIFF format' -> formats [eps, pdf, tiff]. DPI left null: guide says only 'uploaded in the highest resolution possible'; detailed DPI lives in a separate Wiley figure-requirements PDF, not the main guide. legends_location/callout_style/naming_pattern not confirmed -> null.

DECLARATIONS confirmed present on live page: competing-interests/conflict-of-interest statement; Wiley Data Sharing data-availability statement ('select the data availability statement that is right for your submission'); ethics/IRB approval, ethical treatment of participants, informed consent 'as appropriate'; funding statement (Wiley standard). Order shown follows Wiley house standard (the guide does not strictly enumerate a sequence). required = CoI + funding + data_availability; ethics_approval + patient_consent are conditional ('as appropriate').

ORCID required (live page: 'This journal requires ORCID.') -> misc.orcid_required true. title_page.elements inferred from the double-anonymized separate-title-page-with-author-details requirement + ORCID mandate; the guide does not print an explicit enumerated title-page element list.

HIGHLIGHTS/KEY POINTS: live page requires 'no more than 3 key points' published with the article, and lists 'highlights' among items excluded from the word count -> misc.highlights_required true. Separately, a Plain Language Summary is required: 'a single paragraph no more than 200 words long' (no schema field; recorded here).

NOT ENCODED (SUPERSEDED T&F LEGACY numbers surfaced only via search and explicitly attributed to the old Taylor & Francis guide; the task forbids the old guide, so these are NOT encoded and MUST be verified against the live Wiley page before use): Original Paper ~4,000 words; abstract ~250 words; 3-6 keywords; manuscript compile order title page/abstract/keywords/main text/acknowledgements/references/appendices/tables/figure captions. The live Wiley page does confirm a word limit EXISTS for Original Papers and that it 'excludes abstract, highlights, figure/table captions, figures and tables, and reference list' - but the numeric value itself was not obtainable from the blocked page.

cover_letter_required left false (conservative, unverified). abstract.structured false and abstract.max_words / keywords.min/max null because Wiley-page-specific values were not obtainable (only T&F legacy numbers were seen).
[schema-required default] figures.legends_location defaulted to 'in_text' (guide silent; legends left where authored).
2026-07-18 doctrine audit: line_numbers 'none' was a default, not a guide statement — nulled so the engine preserves the author's setting.
